title: California EV charger field-test denominators and success rates
scope: California public charging field tests and visual observations as summarized by CEC staff. These are sample-level aggregates.

calculation_notes.cec_operational_rate_pct: 100 × (accessed ports minus estimated operational failures) / accessed ports. Estimated failures include definite failures and weighted potential failures.
calculation_notes.cec_scar_pct: 100 × successful charge tests / operational plug-in tests. Confirmed nonoperational ports are outside this denominator.
calculation_notes.derived_success_pct_all_plug_in_tests: 100 × successful charge tests / all plug-in tests, including confirmed nonoperational ports. This is an Invariant calculation for the tested subset.
calculation_notes.derived_not_accessed_pct: 100 × ports not accessed / attempted accesses. This is an Invariant calculation. An access failure alone does not establish charger downtime.

source_locators.locator: Overall L2 and Overall DCFC, G3:J25 and K26:L28
